title: POWERPLAY: Training an Increasingly General Problem Solver by Continually Searching for the Simplest Still Unsolvable Problem
problem: Expand a solver's repertoire without forgetting previously acquired skills.
assumption_broken: The tasks used to train a solver need not be externally specified and can instead be invented jointly with solver modifications.
operational_signature: Invent → modify → verify novelty and preservation → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Accept a task-solver pair only after demonstrating that the new solver solves a previously unsolved task while preserving earlier solutions.
limitations_evident: Experiments are deferred to separate papers.
Correctness demonstrations depend on computable task checks.
Search is greedy rather than globally optimal.

title: Bounded Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Enable autonomous goal-directed learning in underspecified circumstances after deployment.
assumption_broken: A deployed system's reasoning behavior can continue improving within designer-imposed boundaries rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Observe → model → prioritize → adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: Value-driven dynamic priority scheduling coordinates parallel reasoning threads using accumulating models of the system and environment.

improver_modified.how: The abstract claims recursive self-improvement through reflective self-modeling, without specifying the modified components.

limitations_evident: Only the abstract is available.
Autonomy remains bounded by designer constraints.

title: Self-Modification of Policy and Utility Function in Rational Agents
problem: Prevent self-modifying agents from undermining their original goals by changing their policy or utility function.
assumption_broken: Goal preservation is not automatic for rational agents and depends on the value function used to judge self-modification.
operational_signature: Consider modifications → predict consequences → evaluate under current goals → select
load_bearing_mechanism: Evaluate future self-modifications with the current utility function while anticipating their effects on future policies.

improver_modified.how: The formal model allows actions to replace the future policy or utility function, including the basis for subsequent choices.

limitations_evident: Results assume optimal policies and explicit knowledge of self-modification consequences.
Safety guarantees hold on-policy.
Preserving an incorrectly specified utility function can obstruct corrigibility and value learning.

title: A Formulation of Recursive Self-Improvement and Its Possible Efficiency
problem: Formalize whether recursively replacing program generators can efficiently reach a target program.
assumption_broken: Improvement can be measured by the ability to generate better future programs rather than immediate task performance.
operational_signature: Generate → score future reachability → compare → replace generator
load_bearing_mechanism: A consistent score orders generators by their expected steps to reach the target and permits only improving transitions.

improver_modified.how: Each accepted program becomes the generator of subsequent candidate programs.

limitations_evident: Precomputing the score costs more than enumerating the entire program space.
Simulations use abstract generators rather than executable self-rewriting programs.
Generation is restricted by a Markov assumption.

title: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET): Endlessly Generating Increasingly Complex and Diverse Learning Environments and Their Solutions
problem: Discover challenging tasks and effective solutions that direct optimization or a single curriculum cannot reach.
assumption_broken: Training environments and their curricula can evolve alongside solutions rather than being fixed by researchers.
operational_signature: Mutate challenges → filter for learnability and novelty → optimize solutions → transfer stepping stones
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-environment transfer of agents preserves useful stepping stones that unlock otherwise inaccessible solutions.
limitations_evident: Environment parameter ranges bound achievable novelty and difficulty.
Agent morphology is fixed.
Experiments are confined to simulated two-dimensional locomotion.

title: AutoML-Zero: Evolving Machine Learning Algorithms From Scratch
problem: Discover complete learning algorithms without restricting search to sophisticated human-designed components.
assumption_broken: The initialization, prediction, and learning rule can all be searched from elementary mathematical instructions.
operational_signature: Mutate programs → execute learning tasks → rank candidates → propagate winners
load_bearing_mechanism: Regularized evolutionary search accumulates executable algorithmic stepping stones in a sparse space of elementary operations.
limitations_evident: Search requires substantial compute even on small proxy tasks.
Transfer required manual hyperparameter decoupling.
Interpreting evolved programs required additional analysis.
closest_prior: Learning to learn by gradient descent by gradient descent

title: Performance of Bounded-Rational Agents With the Ability to Self-Modify
problem: Determine whether self-modification safety survives bounded rationality and imperfect knowledge.
assumption_broken: Near-optimal decision making need not preserve the goal-stability guarantees of perfect rationality.
operational_signature: Bound errors → model self-modification → propagate value loss → compare guarantees
load_bearing_mechanism: Worst-case value-loss bounds distinguish exponentially compounding optimization errors from noncompounding knowledge errors.

improver_modified.how: The theoretical agent can replace its future policy through self-modifying actions.

limitations_evident: Worst-case analysis assumes bounded errors and unlimited self-modification.
No corrigibility mechanism is modeled.
Results use a dualistic agent model and exponential temporal discounting.

title: Emergent Complexity and Zero-shot Transfer via Unsupervised Environment Design
problem: Generate structured, challenging but solvable training environments that prepare policies for novel conditions.
assumption_broken: An adversary should maximize regret rather than simply minimize the learner's reward.
operational_signature: Generate challenges → compare paired returns → update generator → train learner
load_bearing_mechanism: An antagonist supplies a solvability reference so the environment adversary rewards tasks the protagonist fails but another agent can solve.

improver_modified.how: The environment-generating adversary is trained online from regret to adapt the curriculum used for subsequent policy improvement.

limitations_evident: Multi-agent training need not converge.
Regret uses an approximate rather than optimal antagonist.
Demonstrations are limited to navigation and simulated continuous control.

title: GrIPS: Gradient-free, Edit-based Instruction Search for Prompting Large Language Models
problem: Improve discrete task instructions for black-box language models without gradients or manual rewriting.
assumption_broken: Instructions that are semantically coherent to humans are not necessarily the best-performing prompts.
operational_signature: Edit phrases → score predictions → accept improvement → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Greedy phrase-level edits are selected using balanced accuracy and prediction entropy on a small score set.
limitations_evident: Edits cannot add substantially new task information.
Accuracy-based scoring limits applicability to open-ended generation.
Evaluation is limited to eight binary classification tasks and excludes the largest model.

title: GPS: Genetic Prompt Search for Efficient Few-shot Learning
problem: Replace manual prompt engineering with automatic few-shot hard-prompt search without model updates.
assumption_broken: Fluent prompt variants generated automatically can outperform handcrafted templates without tuning model parameters.
operational_signature: Generate variants → score on examples → retain top prompts → reproduce
load_bearing_mechanism: Repeated generative prompt mutation and top-k selection progressively enrich a pool of effective templates.
limitations_evident: Experiments use only ten T0 benchmark tasks.
Comparisons emphasize a 32-example data budget.
Reasons for improved prompts remain unclear.

title: Large Language Models Are Human-Level Prompt Engineers
problem: Automatically find instructions that reliably steer black-box language models toward desired outputs.
assumption_broken: Language models can generate and select their own effective task instructions instead of relying on human prompt engineers.
operational_signature: Infer instructions → execute candidates → filter by score → select instruction
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-generated instruction proposals are filtered by task execution scores, allocating more evaluation to promising candidates.
limitations_evident: Iterative resampling adds only marginal gains over initial proposal selection.
Proposal quality depends strongly on model capability.
Some analysis metrics and configuration choices are computed using test examples.

title: TEMPERA: Test-Time Prompting via Reinforcement Learning
problem: Produce query-dependent discrete prompts efficiently without expensive per-query black-box search.
assumption_broken: A single task-wide prompt need not be shared by all queries; a learned editor can adapt it at inference time.
operational_signature: Encode query and prompt → choose edits → construct tailored prompt → predict
load_bearing_mechanism: A reinforcement-learned editing policy uses consecutive score differences to learn query-conditioned changes to instructions, examples, and verbalizers.

improver_modified.how: The prompt-editing policy is trained with PPO on labeled examples before being frozen for test-time deployment.

limitations_evident: Requires model hidden states rather than only a text API.
Editing is bounded by supplied templates and exemplar pools.
Reported experiments use a fixed RoBERTa-large classification setup.

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
problem: Enable language agents to learn from failed attempts without expensive weight updates.
assumption_broken: Reinforcement can modify persistent linguistic memory rather than model weights.
operational_signature: Attempt → evaluate → reflect → store lessons → retry
load_bearing_mechanism: Task feedback is converted into actionable self-reflections retained as context for subsequent trials.
limitations_evident: Self-reflection depends on reliable evaluation and may reach local minima.
Memory is limited to a small sliding window.
Self-generated tests cannot reliably characterize all code behaviors.

title: WizardLM: Empowering large pre-trained language models to follow complex instructions
problem: Produce diverse high-complexity instruction-tuning data without expensive human annotation.
assumption_broken: Training instruction complexity and diversity can be increased automatically by evolving existing instructions.
operational_signature: Rewrite tasks → generate responses → eliminate failures → accumulate → fine-tune
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled in-depth and in-breadth instruction evolution supplies harder and more diverse training examples.
limitations_evident: Automatic and human evaluations have reliability and scalability limits.
The evaluation set cannot represent every application domain.
Response generation and filtering depend on a capable teacher model.

title: SCM: Enhancing Large Language Model with Self-Controlled Memory Framework
problem: Preserve and retrieve relevant historical information beyond a language model's context limit.
assumption_broken: Long-context capability can be supplied by controlled external memory without modifying or fine-tuning the language model.
operational_signature: Observe → retrieve selectively → reorganize memories → respond → store
load_bearing_mechanism: A memory controller decides whether retrieval is needed and whether summaries suffice, limiting distracting history.
limitations_evident: Dialogue evaluation covers at most 200 turns and 34000 tokens.
The framework requires strong instruction-following models.
Quantitative long-dialogue testing uses only 105 probing questions.

title: Automatic Prompt Optimization with "Gradient Descent" and Beam Search
problem: Direct black-box prompt optimization toward observed errors while reducing expensive candidate evaluations.
assumption_broken: Natural-language critiques can provide a useful optimization direction without differentiating model parameters.
operational_signature: Collect errors → verbalize flaws → rewrite against critiques → bandit-select candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: Error-conditioned textual gradients guide beam expansion while best-arm identification concentrates evaluation budget on promising prompts.
limitations_evident: Reported test scores maxpool over the final candidate beam.
Experiments cover only four classification tasks.
API calls and rate limits can push even small searches past one hour.

title: MemoryBank: Enhancing Large Language Models with Long-Term Memory
problem: Maintain personalized continuity and accurate recall over extended chatbot interactions.
assumption_broken: An LLM's persistent understanding of users can evolve through external memory rather than repeated model training.
operational_signature: Record interactions → summarize events and traits → retrieve context → reinforce or forget
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical conversational memories and evolving user portraits are retrieved to condition personalized responses.
limitations_evident: Quantitative evaluation uses simulated histories for only 15 users over ten days.
The forgetting mechanism is explicitly simplified and exploratory.
Psychological support is demonstrated without clinical effectiveness evaluation.

title: CREATOR: Tool Creation for Disentangling Abstract and Concrete Reasoning of Large Language Models
problem: Overcome limited tool availability and fragile reasoning when solving new problems with language models.
assumption_broken: Language models can create reusable tools rather than merely select from a fixed set of APIs.
operational_signature: Abstract reusable procedure → decide invocation → execute → rectify errors
load_bearing_mechanism: Separating abstract tool creation from concrete invocation reduces reasoning burden and enables execution-guided correction.
limitations_evident: Transfer analysis selects tools known to solve one member of a related problem set.
Evaluation centers on mathematical and tabular reasoning.
Execution without errors does not establish semantic correctness.

title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
problem: Accumulate reusable embodied capabilities during open-ended exploration without fine-tuning model weights.
assumption_broken: An embodied language agent can grow through a library of executable skills and a self-generated curriculum rather than a fixed action repertoire.
operational_signature: Propose task → retrieve skills → generate and repair code → verify → store reusable skill
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful action programs are retained and composed through a skill library, enabling cumulative learning and transfer.
limitations_evident: Depends on costly GPT-4 code generation.
Curriculum and verification can hallucinate or misjudge success.
Uses privileged state and high-level control APIs rather than visual sensorimotor control.

title: Large Language Models as Tool Makers
problem: Reduce the cost of repeatedly solving complex tasks while retaining the performance of a powerful model.
assumption_broken: Expensive reasoning can be amortized into reusable tools that a cheaper language model invokes.
operational_signature: Generate tool → verify and wrap → cache functionality → dispatch and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: A strong tool maker converts task demonstrations into reusable Python functions consumed by a lightweight tool user.
limitations_evident: Tools from weaker models can overfit the few demonstrations.
Accumulated tool-making history strains context limits.
Realistic recurring human-computer interaction datasets are lacking.

title: Retroformer: Retrospective Large Language Agents with Policy Gradient Optimization
problem: Improve the usefulness of agent reflections beyond what a frozen language model can generate.
assumption_broken: The reflection component, rather than the black-box actor, can be trained directly from downstream task rewards.
operational_signature: Attempt → diagnose failure → retry with reflection → measure reward change → train reflector
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy-gradient training rewards reflections according to the improvement in the actor's next episode return.

improver_modified.how: The retrospective language model that proposes prompt refinements is fine-tuned using policy gradients and a replay buffer of reflection outcomes.

limitations_evident: Gains are limited on WebShop, which demands more precise exploration.
Training requires access to a local retrospective model's weights.
Attributing consecutive return changes to reflections relies on limited actor randomness.

title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
problem: Transfer lessons from agent experience across tasks without parameter updates or repeated evaluation-time retries.
assumption_broken: An agent can learn across tasks by retaining general insights and successful trajectories outside its weights.
operational_signature: Collect successes and failures → extract and revise insights → retrieve examples → solve unseen tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Contrasting failed and successful trajectories yields reusable insights that complement retrieval of successful demonstrations.
limitations_evident: Experiments use textual observations and closed-source models.
All extracted insights currently must fit in context.
Cross-validation variation is reported rather than repeated random-seed trials.

title: Confucius: Iterative Tool Learning from Introspection Feedback by Easy-to-Difficult Curriculum
problem: Teach models to select and compose complicated tools from large, noisy candidate sets.
assumption_broken: A static self-instruct dataset is insufficient because tool difficulty depends on the learner's current weaknesses.
operational_signature: Train progressively → identify difficult instances → synthesize targeted examples → retrain
load_bearing_mechanism: High-perplexity tool-use instances guide iterative dataset expansion toward tools the current model has not mastered.
limitations_evident: Unseen-tool performance still declines substantially.
Automatic metrics emphasize schema conformity and reference similarity rather than fully executed outcomes.
Human evaluation covers only 50 sampled cases.

title: Large Language Models as Optimizers
problem: Optimize discrete prompts and other black-box objectives without task-specific update algorithms or gradients.
assumption_broken: An LLM can infer useful search directions from a natural-language problem description and scored solution history.
operational_signature: Present scored history → propose candidates → evaluate objective → retain high scorers → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: A score-sorted trajectory of successful past candidates conditions the LLM to propose progressively stronger solutions.
limitations_evident: Search is sensitive to initialization and exploration settings.
The optimizer does not effectively exploit individual error cases.
Prompt optimization still requires tens of labeled training examples to limit overfitting.

title: EvoPrompt: Connecting LLMs with Evolutionary Algorithms Yields Powerful Prompt Optimizers
problem: Automatically discover effective discrete prompts without gradient access or extensive manual prompt engineering.
assumption_broken: Evolutionary operators need not edit independent tokens because an LLM can implement coherent mutation and crossover in natural language.
operational_signature: Initialize candidates → recombine and mutate → score candidates → retain fitter candidates → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-executed genetic or differential-evolution operators combine coherent prompt generation with fitness-guided population search.
limitations_evident: GPT-3.5 results use only one seed because of budget limits.
BBH development examples are sampled from the test set used for reporting.
Population quality depends on initialization and operator design.

title: Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement Via Prompt Evolution
problem: Hand-crafted prompting strategies and iterative prompt search can plateau before discovering effective domain-specific reasoning instructions.
assumption_broken: The mutation instructions governing prompt search can evolve alongside the task prompts rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Initialize paired candidates → evaluate fitness → select winners → mutate candidates and mutation rules → replace losers
load_bearing_mechanism: Evolution jointly retains task prompts and their mutation prompts, allowing the prompt generator itself to improve through hyper-mutation.

improver_modified.how: Mutation prompts are themselves evolved by hyper-mutation and inherited with successful task prompts.

limitations_evident: The prompting topology and outer evolutionary algorithm remain fixed.
Fitness requires labeled training examples and many evaluations.
Evaluation split and independent-run variance are not detailed in the provided text.

title: CRAFT: Customizing LLMs by Creating and Retrieving from Specialized Toolsets
problem: General-purpose tool APIs do not provide the specialized reusable operations needed for particular downstream problems.
assumption_broken: Task-specific tool libraries can be synthesized and validated from training examples rather than manually supplied.
operational_signature: Sample diverse problems → generate solutions → abstract and validate → deduplicate and store → retrieve and compose
load_bearing_mechanism: Verified abstraction converts individual code solutions into reusable tools that multi-view retrieval selects for new problems.
limitations_evident: Toolset construction costs approximately $2,500.
Validation checks the original problem rather than comprehensive tool correctness.
Weaker backbone models show near-random tool-use performance in the tested setting.

title: Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP): Recursively Self-Improving Code Generation
problem: Manually written language-model scaffolds restrict the quality of generated programs and require human optimizer design.
assumption_broken: A program-improvement scaffold can be submitted to its own improvement procedure rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Propose program edits → evaluate utility → retain best program → apply improver to itself → reuse improved improver
load_bearing_mechanism: The same LM-infused program optimizer rewrites its own scaffolding to discover stronger program-search strategies.

improver_modified.how: The seed program improver is used to rewrite its own executable scaffolding while the underlying language model stays fixed.

limitations_evident: Only the abstract is available for inspection.
Evaluation covers a small set of downstream tasks.
The base language model is not modified and generated code can bypass sandboxing.

title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines
problem: Hard-coded prompt strings make multi-stage language-model pipelines brittle and expensive to adapt to models and tasks.
assumption_broken: Module demonstrations and prompting parameters can be compiled against an end-to-end metric instead of manually authored for every pipeline stage.
operational_signature: Declare modules → execute candidate pipelines → collect successful traces → assign demonstrations → evaluate compiled pipeline
load_bearing_mechanism: Metric-guided bootstrapping turns successful intermediate execution traces into module-specific demonstrations without requiring intermediate labels.
limitations_evident: The provided text omits detailed case-study evaluation protocols.
Developers still specify computational graphs and validation metrics.
Controlled experiments are restricted to two task families.

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
problem: Fixed context windows prevent language-model agents from retaining long conversations and reasoning across large documents.
assumption_broken: Relevant context need not remain permanently in the prompt because the model can manage an external memory hierarchy itself.
operational_signature: Observe events → inspect memory pressure → store or retrieve information → update working context → respond or chain actions
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-directed function calls page information between bounded working context and persistent external memory under explicit control-flow management.
limitations_evident: Reliable operation depends on the base model's function-calling and memory-management abilities.
Retrieval and chained memory operations require additional inference calls.
Conversational evaluation relies on synthetic probes and automatic judgments.

title: Eureka: Human-Level Reward Design via Coding Large Language Models
problem: Manually engineering dense rewards for complex robotic skills is slow and often suboptimal.
assumption_broken: Reward generation need not be restricted to task-specific templates or human-designed reward primitives.
operational_signature: Generate candidates → execute training → summarize component dynamics → mutate the best candidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Component-level reward reflection grounds evolutionary edits in observed policy training dynamics.
limitations_evident: Requires repeated GPU-intensive reinforcement learning
Evaluation is in simulation
Final checkpoint selection uses the task metric

title: PromptAgent: Strategic Planning with Language Models Enables Expert-level Prompt Optimization
problem: Expert prompt construction requires costly domain knowledge and inefficient manual exploration.
assumption_broken: Prompt refinement can be planned over future improvements rather than restricted to local paraphrasing.
operational_signature: Collect errors → reflect → expand candidate states → simulate and select paths
load_bearing_mechanism: Monte Carlo tree search directs error-feedback rewrites toward promising future prompt trajectories.
limitations_evident: Requires labeled examples and repeated model calls
Optimizer depends on strong self-reflection
Search hyperparameters selected using validation rewards

title: Plum: Prompt Learning using Metaheuristic
problem: General interpretable prompt optimization must work without gradients or internal model access.
assumption_broken: Prompt transformations and search strategies can be decoupled rather than fixed to a single heuristic.
operational_signature: Segment candidates → edit or recombine → score outcomes → retain and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Composable prompt neighborhoods let discrete metaheuristics search effectively under limited evaluation budgets.
limitations_evident: Global convergence requires restrictive conditions or an infinite horizon
Image quality is optimized against a learned preference proxy
Search behavior depends on chosen metaheuristic

title: Think-in-Memory: Recalling and Post-thinking Enable LLMs with Long-Term Memory
problem: Repeatedly reasoning over recalled conversation history produces inconsistent answers and costly retrieval.
assumption_broken: Long-term memory can store derived thoughts rather than only raw conversation turns.
operational_signature: Recall relevant thoughts → respond → derive new thoughts → insert, forget, or merge
load_bearing_mechanism: Post-response reasoning persists inductive thoughts and consolidates them for direct later recall.
limitations_evident: Self-generated thoughts can preserve reasoning errors
Medical test set contains only 80 conversations
Additional post-thinking calls are required

title: Explore, Select, Derive, and Recall: Augmenting LLM with Human-like Memory for Mobile Task Automation
problem: Repeated mobile automation through fresh LLM reasoning is unreliable, slow, and costly.
assumption_broken: Past executions can be parameterized and reused at the subtask level rather than regenerated or replayed rigidly.
operational_signature: Explore affordances → select subtasks → execute and store → recall and adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: A hierarchical memory of parameterized subtasks reuses execution procedures across changing task arguments.
limitations_evident: Cost comparisons exclude tasks not completed by all systems
Unsupported image-dominated or non-accessible interfaces
Memory is local to each device

title: Enhancing Open-Domain Task-Solving Capability of LLMs via Autonomous Tool Integration from GitHub
problem: Fixed toolsets prevent agents from solving evolving specialized open-domain queries.
assumption_broken: Agents can acquire and adapt repositories as tools rather than rely on a predefined tool inventory.
operational_signature: Search resources → configure execution → solve and summarize → retrieve prior environments
load_bearing_mechanism: Bi-level experience learning combines community fixes with reusable execution environments and self-summarized practices.
limitations_evident: Experience experiment reruns the same queries on two repositories
Repository changes threaten reproducibility
Docker environments consume substantial resources

title: EASYTOOL: Enhancing LLM-based Agents with Concise Tool Instruction
problem: Inconsistent, redundant, and incomplete tool documentation impairs tool selection and argument generation.
assumption_broken: Tool documentation is an optimizable interface rather than a fixed input to the agent.
operational_signature: Extract purpose → standardize parameters → generate examples → verify execution
load_bearing_mechanism: Concise standardized descriptions plus execution-checked usage examples make tool interfaces easier for models to follow.
limitations_evident: Documentation must fit the model context
Cross-tool dependencies are not modeled
Requires instruction-following models

title: OS-Copilot: Towards Generalist Computer Agents with Self-Improvement
problem: General computer agents cannot scale manually tailored tools to unfamiliar operating-system applications.
assumption_broken: An agent can acquire application-control tools through its own curriculum instead of requiring a fixed human-built toolkit.
operational_signature: Propose practice tasks → generate tools → execute and critique → retain and retrieve skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-directed practice accumulates executable tools in procedural memory for reuse on unseen requests.
limitations_evident: Success assessment without ground truth depends on an LLM critic
Spreadsheet evaluation has only 20 tasks
Requires broad operating-system access

title: PRompt Optimization in Multi-Step Tasks (PROMST): Integrating Human Feedback and Heuristic-based Sampling
problem: Long-horizon agent prompts are difficult to refine because failures are hard to diagnose and candidate rollouts are expensive.
assumption_broken: Feedback diagnosis need not come from the LLM itself, and every generated prompt need not receive a full rollout.
operational_signature: Execute candidates → synthesize rule-based feedback → rewrite prompts → filter with learned scores
load_bearing_mechanism: Human-designed error feedback guides prompt revision while an online score predictor prunes costly low-quality evaluations.

improver_modified.how: The score-prediction component is fine-tuned online on newly collected prompt-score pairs.

limitations_evident: Requires task-specific human feedback rules
Search still needs roughly 100 expensive candidate evaluations
Score models need substantial data and local compute

title: Offline Training of Language Model Agents with Functions as Learnable Weights
problem: Manual tool curation and inaccessible model weights limit adaptation of language-model agents.
assumption_broken: Agent functions can serve as trainable parameters while the underlying language model remains frozen.
operational_signature: Evaluate tasks → inspect traces → add, revise, or remove functions → roll back regressions
load_bearing_mechanism: Progressive function updates with rollback preserve useful capabilities while optimizing training-set success.
limitations_evident: Small training subsets imposed by context and API cost
Training improvements can overfit and reduce test performance
Optimization requires repeated complete training-set evaluations

title: Language Agents as Optimizable Graphs
problem: Manually engineered prompting and agent orchestration fragment systems and leave collaboration structures suboptimal.
assumption_broken: Inter-agent connectivity and node prompts can be optimized instead of remaining fixed architecture choices.
operational_signature: Compose operations → sample connections → execute and score → update connection probabilities and prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: REINFORCE optimizes a distribution over acyclic communication graphs while node-level optimization adapts individual prompts.
limitations_evident: Graphs restricted to directed acyclic structures
Crossword optimization and evaluation reuse a 20-problem subset
Utility evaluation requires repeated graph executions

title: Unleashing the Potential of Large Language Models as Prompt Optimizers: Analogical Analysis with Gradient-based Model Optimizers
problem: LLM-based prompt optimizers lack principled guidance for choosing update information and refinement magnitude.
assumption_broken: Prompt update history and edit distance can be controlled analogously to momentum and learning-rate schedules.
operational_signature: Retrieve relevant history → generate constrained variants → score candidates → retain best and decay edits
load_bearing_mechanism: Relevance-selected optimization trajectories and cosine-decayed edit limits guide progressively finer prompt generation.
limitations_evident: Analogy restricted to common first-order optimizers
Relies on textual update directions
Condensed text omits detailed final evaluation splits

title: Agent-Pro: Learning to Evolve via Policy-Level Reflection and Optimization
problem: Action-level self-correction fails to learn strategic policies from delayed feedback in imperfect-information games.
assumption_broken: Reflection can revise underlying beliefs and general behavioral instructions rather than only individual actions.
operational_signature: Play and record beliefs → diagnose failed policies → verify revised instructions → search policy improvements
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy-level belief calibration converts failed trajectories into verified behavioral guidelines and world models.
limitations_evident: Evaluated only on Blackjack and Texas Holdem
Strong dependence on foundation-model reflection
Potential gap to state-of-the-art game solvers

title: LLMs in the Imaginarium: Tool Learning through Simulated Trial and Error
problem: Broad tool access does not ensure accurate tool calls even for tools already seen during training.
assumption_broken: Tool expertise can be acquired by imagined practice with real execution feedback rather than static documentation alone.
operational_signature: Imagine scenarios → execute and refine → distill memories → retrieve demonstrations or fine-tune
load_bearing_mechanism: Short-term trial traces and long-term exploration summaries improve the validity and diversity of tool-learning examples.
limitations_evident: Tests are drawn from synthesized exploration examples
End-to-end resolution of time-varying user queries is not evaluated
Positive examples do not teach when to avoid tools

title: Self-Improving Customer Review Response Generation Based on LLMs
problem: High volumes of app reviews make accurate app-specific customer responses difficult to produce manually.
assumption_broken: Response-generation prompts can improve automatically through category-specific judge feedback rather than manual prompt engineering.
operational_signature: Generate grounded responses → judge dimensions → diagnose weak cases → rewrite and rescore prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: Category-specific LLM critiques of low-scoring responses are distilled into reusable prompt instructions.
limitations_evident: Only 49 reviews for one application
Judge relevance and specificity correlate negatively with humans on the test set
Accuracy judging uses expert answers unavailable during deployment

title: Prompt Optimization with Human Feedback
problem: Numeric prompt-quality scores are often unavailable or unreliable in direct user interactions.
assumption_broken: Prompt search can use only pairwise preferences rather than scalar scores or labeled validation access.
operational_signature: Generate candidate pool → predict latent utilities → query a preference pair → update the utility model
load_bearing_mechanism: A neural dueling-bandit rule pairs a predicted best prompt with an uncertainty-aware challenger.

improver_modified.how: The latent utility predictor is retrained on accumulated preference observations after each iteration.

limitations_evident: Main prompt experiments simulate preferences rather than collect real user judgments
Optimization is restricted to a pregenerated candidate pool
Does not handle rankings of more than two alternatives

title: Buffer of Thoughts: Thought-Augmented Reasoning with Large Language Models
problem: Reasoning methods repeatedly reconstruct expensive solution structures and fail to reuse general insights.
assumption_broken: Reusable high-level reasoning templates can replace fresh reasoning-structure search for each instance.
operational_signature: Distill constraints → retrieve template → instantiate solution → distill and update templates
load_bearing_mechanism: A dynamically managed meta-buffer stores general thought templates for adaptive instantiation on later problems.
limitations_evident: Limited gains for creative problems
Weak models produce poorer initial templates
Template distillation is not itself optimized

title: TextGrad: Automatic "Differentiation" via Text
problem: Compound AI systems with nondifferentiable components lack general automated optimization methods.
assumption_broken: Feedback can propagate through arbitrary components in natural language without numeric differentiability.
operational_signature: Execute computation graph → critique objective → backpropagate textual feedback → update variables
load_bearing_mechanism: Context-aware textual gradients attribute downstream criticism to upstream variables for targeted revision.
limitations_evident: Depends on LLMs reasoning accurately about optimized components
Scientific applications validated only in silico
Extra model calls grow with computation-graph edges

title: Optimizing Instructions and Demonstrations for Multi-Stage Language Model Programs
problem: Multi-stage LM programs need jointly effective module prompts without intermediate labels or gradients.
assumption_broken: Instructions and demonstrations across modules can be jointly optimized using only an end-to-end metric.

operational_signature: Explore → reflect → consolidate → abstract → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Structured reflection converts interaction trajectories into persistent memories and reusable procedural lessons.
limitations_evident: Simulated college environment rather than real-world deployment
Current agents lack self-motivation and robust long-term memory
Framework ambitions exceed the evaluation details supplied

title: Learning Game-Playing Agents with Generative Code Optimization
problem: Deep reinforcement learning requires many interactions and produces opaque policies for long-horizon gameplay.
assumption_broken: Sequential decision policies can be optimized as readable Python programs rather than neural weights.
operational_signature: Execute → trace → diagnose → rewrite → reevaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: OptoPrime rewrites modular policy code using execution traces and staged feedback from longer gameplay evaluations.
limitations_evident: Game-specific scaffolds and staged human strategies
Context limits force short traced rollouts
LLM edits can destabilize policies

title: Memory-R1: Enhancing Large Language Model Agents to Manage and Utilize Memories via Reinforcement Learning
problem: Heuristic memory operations and unfiltered retrieval impair long-context dialogue reasoning.
assumption_broken: Memory editing and filtering policies can be learned from downstream answer outcomes without operation-level labels.
operational_signature: Extract → retrieve → edit → filter → answer → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: Outcome-based PPO or GRPO trains memory operations and answer-time memory distillation with exact-match rewards.

improver_modified.how: The Memory Manager that writes external memories is itself fine-tuned using downstream QA rewards.

limitations_evident: Dialogue-only evaluation
Separately trained agents complicate coordination
Adversarial questions excluded from LoCoMo evaluation

title: Middo: Model-Informed Dynamic Data Optimization for Enhanced LLM Fine-Tuning via Closed-Loop Learning
problem: Static data filtering and synthesis fail to track changing model learning needs.
assumption_broken: Training examples can be repeatedly repaired in response to the learner rather than curated once and held fixed.
operational_signature: Diagnose → select → rewrite → train → rediagnose
load_bearing_mechanism: Loss, embedding sparsity, and self-alignment jointly identify examples for context-preserving refinement.

improver_modified.how: The learner supplying loss, embeddings, and quality scores is retrained on each refined dataset.

limitations_evident: Diagnostics require a sufficiently capable learner
Repeated retraining and synthesis increase cost
Initial data biases may propagate

title: ArcMemo: Abstract Reasoning Composition with Lifelong LLM Memory
problem: Reasoning discoveries are discarded between queries or stored as overly specific examples that transfer poorly.
assumption_broken: Reusable reasoning memory can consist of modular abstract concepts rather than complete solution instances.
operational_signature: Solve → verify → abstract → store → select → compose
load_bearing_mechanism: Parameterized concept memories distilled from verified solution traces enable selective retrieval and recombination.
limitations_evident: Requires feedback to avoid storing flawed concepts
Evaluation covers 100 public ARC puzzles
Selection can omit useful concepts and introduce distractors

title: Code2MCP: Transforming Code Repositories into MCP Services
problem: The MCP ecosystem lacks an automated supply of reliable tools derived from existing repositories.
assumption_broken: Agent-ready tool pools can be generated and repaired automatically rather than assumed to exist.
operational_signature: Analyze → wrap → execute → diagnose → repair → package
load_bearing_mechanism: A multi-agent Run-Review-Fix loop uses execution tracebacks to repair generated MCP adapters.
limitations_evident: Environment reconstruction and interface inference dominate failures
Script-driven and interactive repositories remain difficult
Adversarial repositories are not evaluated

title: SEDM: Selective Self-Evolving Distributed Memory for Agents
problem: Indiscriminate sharing and injection of agent memories increases cost and can reduce success.
assumption_broken: Relevant or previously useful memory should not automatically be retained or used for every recipient.
operational_signature: Replay → admit → rank → abstract → calibrate → gate
load_bearing_mechanism: Paired outcomes estimate memory utility for admission and train a calibrated gate that weighs expected success gains against context cost.

improver_modified.how: The recipient memory gate is trained on paired outcomes and calibrated on a separate split.

limitations_evident: Original headline admission tests memories on their source tasks
Gate tests use frozen memory and one agent backbone
Held-out LoCoMo test contains only one conversation

title: Learning to Optimize Multi-Objective Alignment Through Dynamic Reward Weighting
problem: Fixed reward scalarization wastes training effort and misses non-convex multi-objective trade-offs.
assumption_broken: Reward weights can evolve during alignment rather than remain fixed preference constants.
operational_signature: Measure → estimate influence → reweight → update → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Hypervolume contributions or cross-objective gradient influence dynamically redirect learning toward improvable objectives.

improver_modified.how: Reward weights controlling subsequent policy updates are adapted using hypervolume or gradient feedback.

limitations_evident: Irreducible objective conflicts limit gains
Hypervolume meta-rewards need calibration
Gradient method relaxes clipping and KL safeguards to preserve linearity

title: PRINCIPLES: Synthetic Strategy Memory for Proactive Dialogue Agents
problem: Proactive dialogue planners have limited strategy coverage, preference bias, and expensive training requirements.
assumption_broken: Strategy knowledge can be elicited into reusable contrasting principles rather than learned through additional parameter updates.
operational_signature: Simulate → score → backtrack → revise → distill → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful and repaired failed self-play turns yield situation-specific principles contrasting effective and ineffective strategies.
limitations_evident: Embedding retrieval misses nuanced situations
Turn-level reward lacks explicit long-term goals
Simulation-derived emotional support strategies lack expert validation

title: ShinkaEvolve: Towards Open-Ended And Sample-Efficient Program Evolution
problem: LLM program evolution wastes evaluations on redundant mutations and inefficient exploration.
assumption_broken: Mutation-model choice and archive sampling need not remain static during program search.
operational_signature: Sample → mutate → reject redundancy → execute → archive → adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: Novelty filtering, exploration-aware parent sampling, and improvement-based bandit model selection make evolution sample-efficient.

improver_modified.how: Observed mutation gains update LLM sampling probabilities and periodic meta-scratchpad guidance.

limitations_evident: Requires human-defined numerical objectives and evaluators
Exploration settings remain partly fixed
API costs remain a barrier

title: SGMem: Sentence Graph Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
problem: Fragmented dialogue history and generated memories hinder coherent long-term retrieval.
assumption_broken: Conversational memory graphs need not rely on costly extracted entity-relation triples or coarse chunks alone.
operational_signature: Segment → embed → link → retrieve → expand → integrate
load_bearing_mechanism: Sentence-level similarity graphs recover coherent parent chunks and combine them with generated memory.
limitations_evident: Generated memories may contain unverified hallucinations
No streaming or multimodal evaluation
Large-scale graph maintenance overhead is unoptimized

title: SPELL: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning for Evolving Long-Context Language Models
problem: Long-context reasoning lacks scalable reliable annotations and programmatically verifiable rewards.
assumption_broken: One evolving policy can jointly generate tasks, solve them, and supply semantic verification rather than depend on fixed external supervision.
operational_signature: Generate → ground → solve → verify → balance → update
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint GRPO across questioner, responder, and verifier maintains a competence-matched curriculum with semantic consensus rewards.

improver_modified.how: Shared-policy updates improve the question generator and semantic verifier alongside the responder.

limitations_evident: Consensus can preserve shared verification errors
Role imbalance requires specialized sampling
Training uses a 16K context ceiling

title: MemGen: Weaving Generative Latent Memory for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: External retrieval is rigid and full-model experiential tuning risks catastrophic forgetting.
assumption_broken: Memory can be generated as latent tokens during reasoning rather than retrieved once or embedded in updated core weights.
operational_signature: Monitor → trigger → synthesize → insert → continue → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: Separately trained trigger and weaver adapters insert state-conditioned latent memories into a frozen reasoner.

improver_modified.how: Training updates the memory-generating weaver and the policy deciding when to invoke it while freezing the core reasoner.

limitations_evident: Latent memories are not human-readable
Adapter training remains necessary
Memory invocation introduces inference overhead

title: Socratic-Zero : Bootstrapping Reasoning via Data-Free Agent Co-evolution
problem: Static synthetic reasoning datasets cannot adapt to solver weaknesses or maintain useful curriculum difficulty.
assumption_broken: A learned curriculum generator can evolve with a solver rather than rely on a frozen synthetic corpus.
operational_signature: Attempt → judge → expose weakness → refine tasks → distill → retrain
load_bearing_mechanism: Teacher-verified preference learning improves the solver while utility-weighted distillation trains a generator near its competence frontier.

improver_modified.how: The Generator learns the fixed Teacher's failure-targeted question refinement strategy through value-weighted fine-tuning.

limitations_evident: Data-free framing still requires 100 seeds and 1,500 SFT initialization problems
Relies on a large fixed teacher
Generated-problem counts are internally inconsistent

title: LatentEvolve: Self-Evolving Test-Time Scaling in Latent Space
problem: Independent test-time reasoning runs discard optimization experience instead of improving future scaling.
assumption_broken: Inference-time adaptation can accumulate reusable optimization trajectories without changing the core LLM.
operational_signature: Retrieve → transfer momentum → refine → archive → consolidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Retrieved latent optimization deltas initialize new reasoning, while a learned weaver periodically consolidates high-confidence traces.

improver_modified.how: Nighttime training updates the latent weaver that initializes subsequent daytime optimization.

limitations_evident: Self-rewards can mistake confidence for correctness
Latent refinement requires repeated sampled generations
Benchmarks are adapted on their own test streams

title: ReasoningBank: Scaling Agent Self-Evolving with Reasoning Memory
problem: Persistent agents repeat errors because past interactions are discarded or preserved only as low-level success routines.
assumption_broken: Failed trajectories and contrastive exploration can produce reusable strategy memory without ground-truth labels.
operational_signature: Retrieve → explore → self-judge → contrast → distill → accumulate
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-judged successes and failures are abstracted into strategy memories, with scaled exploration enriching contrastive extraction.
limitations_evident: Self-judgment supplies imperfect correctness proxies
Memory consolidation simply appends entries
Additional exploration raises per-task compute

title: Mem-α: Learning Memory Construction via Reinforcement Learning
problem: Untuned agents fail to select and organize useful information in complex multi-component memories.
assumption_broken: Memory-write policies can be learned directly from downstream utility rather than prescribed by instructions.
operational_signature: Read chunk → write → retrieve → answer → reward → update
load_bearing_mechanism: GRPO trains structured memory construction using downstream QA accuracy plus execution, semantic-validity, and compression rewards.

improver_modified.how: The memory-writing policy is reinforced while retrieval and answer generation stay frozen.

limitations_evident: Conflict resolution evaluation is excluded
Training requires 32 H100 GPUs for three days
Production latency, safety, and database integration remain untested

title: AgenticEval: Toward Agentic and Self-Evolving Safety Evaluation of Large Language Models
problem: Static safety benchmarks lag evolving risks and fail to operationalize complex regulations.
assumption_broken: Safety evaluation can adapt its tests to target-specific failure modes instead of remaining a one-time fixed audit.
operational_signature: Structure rules → ground → generate → evaluate → diagnose → retarget
load_bearing_mechanism: An analyst converts rubric-judged model failures into directives for progressively targeted test generation.
limitations_evident: Policy interpretation is not legal certification
LLM judge hallucinations and capability mismatches may misclassify responses
Adaptive testing increases cost and latency

title: Your Agent May Misevolve: Emergent Risks in Self-evolving LLM Agents
problem: Task-driven self-evolution can degrade alignment and introduce vulnerabilities unnoticed by static safety assessments.
assumption_broken: Improving task utility does not imply that evolving agent components remain safe.
operational_signature: Evolve → probe safety → track drift → diagnose → mitigate
load_bearing_mechanism: Longitudinal and before-after safety audits expose risks across parameter, memory, tool, and workflow evolution.
limitations_evident: Mitigations only partly restore initial safety
Proposed static tool verification is not tested
Different pathways use different systems and benchmarks

title: Improving Code Localization with Repository Memory
problem: Localization agents waste effort rediscovering repository knowledge for every issue.
assumption_broken: A bug localization task need not start without prior knowledge of repository evolution.
operational_signature: Collect history → summarize hotspots → retrieve precedent → inspect → localize
load_bearing_mechanism: Historical commits and summaries of frequently edited files provide complementary priors for graph-based localization.
limitations_evident: Sparse or irrelevant histories can distract and degrade performance
Average cost increases and varies sharply per issue
Evaluation targets file localization rather than completed fixes

title: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models
problem: Repeated context rewriting discards useful domain detail and collapses accumulated agent knowledge.
assumption_broken: Adapted contexts need not be concise monolithic summaries; detailed playbooks can grow incrementally.
operational_signature: Generate → reflect → curate deltas → merge → refine → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Localized structured delta updates preserve prior strategies while adding new lessons without monolithic rewriting.
limitations_evident: Requires a sufficiently capable reflector
Detailed contexts can be redundant for simple tasks
Online results adapt sequentially on test samples

title: CAM: A Constructivist View of Agentic Memory for LLM-Based Reading Comprehension
problem: Long-text memory systems struggle to preserve associations while efficiently incorporating newly arriving document batches.
assumption_broken: Memory hierarchies need not force exclusive membership or require global reconstruction after updates.
operational_signature: Connect → disentangle → cluster incrementally → summarize → prune and grow → respond
load_bearing_mechanism: Local-first incremental overlapping clustering updates only affected hierarchical abstractions while allowing chunks to support multiple summaries.
limitations_evident: Hierarchical summaries can propagate hallucinations
Assumes internally consistent sources
Fixed prompts and hyperparameters do not learn from downstream feedback

title: Scientific Algorithm Discovery by Augmenting AlphaEvolve with Deep Research
problem: Algorithm evolution plateaus when proposals rely only on internal model knowledge, while untested research ideas often cannot be implemented.
assumption_broken: Scientific code evolution need not operate without external research or restrict mutations to a single file.
operational_signature: Research → propose → edit → debug → evaluate → archive → sample
load_bearing_mechanism: Feedback-grounded deep research supplies implementable hypotheses to multi-file evolution with automatic debugging.
limitations_evident: Repeated selection uses supplied evaluation scores with unclear held-out separation
Training-heavy proposals often exceed runtime limits
Gains depend strongly on initial algorithm maturity

title: Training-Free Group Relative Policy Optimization
problem: Specialized agent adaptation through parameter tuning is expensive and data hungry.
assumption_broken: Group-relative policy improvement need not change weights; experience expressed as context can steer a frozen model.
operational_signature: Sample groups → score → contrast → distill → edit experience → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Comparing rewarded winners and losers yields semantic advantages that update an external experience library.
limitations_evident: Main comparisons use different model sizes and training budgets
Repeated inference runs are reported without clear variance estimates
Default semantic advantages require groups containing both winners and losers

title: Evolution in Simulation: AI-Agent School with Dual Memory for High-Fidelity Educational Dynamics
problem: Educational simulations lack realistic evolving role behavior and coherent models of teacher-student interactions.
assumption_broken: Role behavior need not remain fixed; interaction-derived experience and knowledge can refine it over time.
operational_signature: Interact → reflect → separate experience and knowledge → prioritize → retrieve → adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate experience and knowledge stores with salient short-term subsets support reflection and role-consistent reuse.
limitations_evident: Only 50 agents over five simulated days
Evaluation and evolution rely on one expert-curated scenario set
Text-only agents cannot model visual or nonverbal cues

title: EvoTest: Evolutionary Test-Time Learning for Self-Improving Agentic Systems
problem: Agents struggle to improve from a few repeated attempts at sparse-reward long-horizon tasks.
assumption_broken: Test-time adaptation need not be limited to memory, prompts, or parameter updates in isolation.
operational_signature: Act → analyze transcript → mutate configuration → select by confidence → retry
load_bearing_mechanism: Whole-system configuration evolution converts narrative feedback into coordinated behavioral changes selected by UCB.
limitations_evident: Learns on identical resets of the same six games rather than unseen task transfer
Weight-update baselines use a different backbone
Equal action budgets do not establish equal adaptation compute

title: MemoTime: Memory-Augmented Temporal Knowledge Graph Enhanced Large Language Model Reasoning
problem: Temporal QA pipelines violate time constraints and repeatedly reconstruct reasoning strategies across related questions.
assumption_broken: Temporal retrieval and decomposition need not be static or discard previously verified reasoning experience.
operational_signature: Ground → decompose → recall → retrieve under constraints → verify → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Operator-aware hierarchical reasoning reuses verified experience while enforcing shared temporal constraints on retrieved paths.
limitations_evident: Memory construction and test-stream separation are not specified in supplied text
Requires structured temporal knowledge graphs
Verification relies on LLM judgments and voting

title: Towards Agentic Self-Learning LLMs in Search Environment
problem: Open-domain search agents lack scalable tasks and reliable automatically verifiable rewards.
assumption_broken: Task generation and reward verification need not remain fixed while a policy learns.
operational_signature: Generate → solve → judge → jointly update
load_bearing_mechanism: Co-training a shared-backbone task generator, solver, and generative reward model maintains informative supervision as task difficulty increases.

improver_modified.how: The task generator and generative reward model are themselves updated through reinforcement learning each cycle.

limitations_evident: Only text-based search agents are evaluated.
Verification capacity eventually limits continued improvement.
Late-stage gains can require real verification data.

title: DRO-InstructZero: Distributionally Robust Prompt Optimization for Large Language Models
problem: Average-case prompt optimization yields brittle instructions under distribution shift.
assumption_broken: The evaluation distribution need not be fixed and representative of deployment.
operational_signature: Propose → evaluate → reweight → acquire
load_bearing_mechanism: A distributionally robust Bayesian acquisition maximizes worst-case utility over an ambiguity set rather than nominal average accuracy.
limitations_evident: Adversarial reweighting adds computation.
Divergence and radius are fixed.
Reported task counts and divergence formulations are inconsistent.

title: EvolveR: Self-Evolving LLM Agents through an Experience-Driven Lifecycle
problem: Agents forget interaction outcomes and cannot systematically refine reusable problem-solving strategies.
assumption_broken: Experience need not remain raw retrieved cases or transient reflections disconnected from policy learning.
operational_signature: Interact → distill → curate → retrieve → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-distilled strategic principles are deduplicated and utility-scored, retrieved during interaction, and integrated with reinforcement learning.

improver_modified.how: The policy that distills principles is itself updated through GRPO between experience-distillation phases.

limitations_evident: Small models have limited self-distillation ability.
Experiments concentrate on question answering.
Training requires reinforcement learning and experience-base maintenance.

title: RGMem: Renormalization Group-inspired Memory Evolution for Language Agents
problem: Flat fact-level memories cannot preserve stable user traits while adapting to conflicting cross-session evidence.
assumption_broken: All conversational memories need not evolve at the same abstraction scale or update rate.
operational_signature: Extract → aggregate → threshold → abstract → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical coarse-graining and evidence-thresholded updates separate fast-changing facts from slowly evolving user traits.
limitations_evident: Only two conversational memory benchmarks are evaluated.
Update thresholds require calibration.
Renormalization is an engineering analogy rather than an explicitly optimized physical objective.

title: DelvePO: Direction-Guided Self-Evolving Framework for Flexible Prompt Optimization
problem: Random whole-prompt rewriting loses useful components and converges prematurely.
assumption_broken: Prompt mutation need not be directionless or operate on an indivisible instruction.
operational_signature: Decompose → recall → mutate → recombine → rank
load_bearing_mechanism: Component-level and whole-prompt memories guide which prompt components evolve and how their values are mutated or crossed.

improver_modified.how: Performance-ranked component and prompt memories are updated to guide subsequent evolutionary operations.

limitations_evident: Memory context increases token costs.
Promptbreeder and ablations use only one seed.
Component values and model coverage are resource-limited.

title: Search Self-play: Pushing the Frontier of Agent Capability without Supervision
problem: Agentic reinforcement learning is constrained by scarce verified questions and static synthetic task difficulty.
assumption_broken: Search training tasks need not be supplied by humans or a frozen offline synthesizer.
operational_signature: Search → propose → verify → challenge → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: RAG verification filters unanswerable proposals while adversarial proposer-solver co-training continually raises task difficulty.

improver_modified.how: The question proposer is updated with REINFORCE while the solver is updated with GRPO.

limitations_evident: Evaluations use small benchmark subsamples.
Correctness depends on an LLM judge and RAG verification.
Experiments use a fixed Wikipedia retrieval environment.

title: LightMem: Lightweight and Efficient Memory-Augmented Generation
problem: Persistent agent memories impose excessive token, API-call, and online maintenance overhead.
assumption_broken: Memory consolidation need not process every turn independently or occur synchronously during inference.
operational_signature: Compress → segment → summarize → insert → consolidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Topic-aware compressed buffering reduces construction calls while sleep-time parallel updates decouple expensive consolidation from online inference.
limitations_evident: Compression and buffer thresholds trade accuracy against cost.
Stored dialogue introduces privacy and misinformation risks.
Evaluation centers on text conversation memory.

title: How to Auto-optimize Prompts for Domain Tasks? Adaptive Prompting and Reasoning through Evolutionary Domain Knowledge Adaptation
problem: Imperfect expert knowledge and poorly integrated reasoning guidance limit domain-specific LLM predictions.
assumption_broken: Expert semantic causal graphs need not be complete, correct, or fixed during prompt optimization.
operational_signature: Ground → predict → critique → alternate edits → accept
load_bearing_mechanism: Ground-truth textual gradients alternately refine semantic causal graphs and reasoning prompts, accepting only individual improvements.
limitations_evident: Best of three API runs is reported rather than variance.
Validation and test sets contain only 100 instances each.
Additional textual-gradient computation and API instability remain.

title: Huxley-Gödel Machine: Human-Level Coding Agent Development by an Approximation of the Optimal Self-Improving Machine
problem: Immediate coding benchmark performance poorly predicts which self-modifying agents will generate productive descendants.
assumption_broken: The highest-performing current agent need not be the best parent for further self-improvement.
operational_signature: Estimate descendants → sample parent → self-edit → evaluate → archive
load_bearing_mechanism: Clade-level metaproductivity estimates guide Thompson-sampling expansion while adaptive scheduling separates evaluation from modification.

improver_modified.how: Archived coding agents modify their own codebases and can change their subsequent self-modification capabilities.

limitations_evident: The theoretical oracle result relies on restricted cost and repeatability assumptions.
Optimization on benchmark tasks can overfit.
A baseline terminates early because of context-window failures.

title: Multi-Agent Evolve: LLM Self-Improve through Co-evolution
problem: General-domain self-play lacks reliable training feedback without labels or executable verifiers.
assumption_broken: Self-play learning need not be restricted to environments with externally verifiable rewards.
operational_signature: Propose → filter → solve → judge → synchronize updates
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared-backbone proposer-solver-judge triad combines adversarial difficulty rewards, quality filtering, and synchronized reinforcement learning.

improver_modified.how: Shared-backbone updates change the proposer and judge along with the solver; the judge receives format rewards.

limitations_evident: Only Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct is evaluated.
Judge correctness is not externally grounded during learning.
Question diversity and dataset corruption can destabilize training.

title: Alita-G: Self-Evolving Generative Agent for Agent Generation
problem: Generalist agents repeatedly reconstruct domain-specific sub-solutions instead of reusing specialized tools.
assumption_broken: Agent adaptation need not be confined to prompt rewriting or retries; generated executable tools can persist across tasks.
operational_signature: Execute → harvest successes → parameterize → index → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful task trajectories yield abstracted MCP primitives whose descriptions and use cases support focused retrieval at inference.
limitations_evident: GAIA validation tasks are used for both tool harvesting and evaluation.
PathVQA and HLE evaluations use 100 examples each.
Reported inference savings exclude full tool-generation costs.

title: SPICE: Self-Play In Corpus Environments Improves Reasoning
problem: Ungrounded self-play plateaus through hallucination amplification and identical proposer-solver knowledge.
assumption_broken: Self-play task generation need not rely only on knowledge internalized by the solver.
operational_signature: Sample documents → generate → hide context → solve → co-train
load_bearing_mechanism: Corpus-grounded information asymmetry and variance-based challenger rewards create a renewable frontier-difficulty curriculum.

improver_modified.how: The challenger and reasoner share weights jointly updated with role-specific DrGRPO advantages.

limitations_evident: Document grounding does not independently prove generated question correctness.
Benefits depend on corpus content and diversity.
Training-run variance is not reported in the provided text.

title: Scaling Agent Learning via Experience Synthesis
problem: Real-environment rollouts are expensive, sparse, and difficult to scale for agent reinforcement learning.
assumption_broken: Effective agent training need not require perfectly realistic or directly executed environment transitions.
operational_signature: Retrieve experience → simulate transitions → train → generate challenges → replenish
load_bearing_mechanism: A reasoning-based textual experience model grounded in replay trajectories synthesizes rollouts and entropy-targeted task curricula.

improver_modified.how: The replay buffer conditioning the experience model is continuously enriched with new synthetic interactions.

limitations_evident: Primarily single-environment training.
Transfer to substantially different embodied domains degrades.
Synthetic dynamics depend on limited offline real trajectories.

title: Self-Abstraction from Grounded Experience for Plan-Guided Policy Refinement
problem: Static software agents fail to turn long, noisy first-attempt trajectories into effective subsequent repair strategies.
assumption_broken: A coding agent need not solve a task from scratch in one rollout or reuse the entire raw trajectory.
operational_signature: Explore → abstract plan → reset → execute with guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: A concise plan induced from grounded execution captures dependencies and constraints for a second attempt without external verifier feedback.
limitations_evident: Plans are reused on the same issue rather than demonstrated across tasks.
Evaluation is restricted to SWE-bench Verified.
Self-assessment bias reduces plan quality relative to some cross-model planners.

title: FLEX: Continuous Agent Evolution via Forward Learning from Experience
problem: Frozen agents cannot accumulate scalable, transferable learning from deployment experiences without costly parameter updates.
assumption_broken: Learning need not modify weights or remain tied to the model that generated the experience.
operational_signature: Explore → reflect → update library → retrieve → reason
load_bearing_mechanism: A persistent semantic experience library distills successes and failures into reusable guidance that can be inherited across models.
limitations_evident: Scientific task evaluations often use small training or test subsets.
Library growth increases stored experience and retrieval demands.
Scaling evidence is concentrated on GSM8k.

title: RLVE: Scaling Up Reinforcement Learning for Language Models with Adaptive Verifiable Environments
problem: Static reasoning datasets saturate and waste reinforcement-learning rollouts on problems that are too easy or hard.
assumption_broken: Procedural environment difficulty need not remain fixed throughout policy training.
operational_signature: Sample difficulty → generate → verify → train → raise frontier
load_bearing_mechanism: Per-environment sliding difficulty windows advance when frontier accuracy crosses a threshold, maintaining informative reward variation.
limitations_evident: All 400 environments require substantial manual engineering.
Non-verifiable open-ended domains are not addressed.
Difficulty control depends on environment-specific parameters.

title: From Experience to Strategy: Empowering LLM Agents with Trainable Graph Memory
problem: Static explicit memory cannot adaptively prioritize useful experience or effectively guide policy learning.
assumption_broken: Human-readable strategic memory need not remain untrained or be used only at inference.
operational_signature: Abstract paths → induce strategies → compare rewards → reweight graph → guide learning
load_bearing_mechanism: REINFORCE updates graph edges using the reward difference between strategy-guided and unguided trajectories, prioritizing causally useful guidance.

improver_modified.how: Learned graph weights change the strategy-retrieval mechanism used to guide subsequent policy training.

limitations_evident: Utility estimation requires paired guided and unguided rollouts.
Too many retrieved strategies introduce noise.
Empirical validation concentrates on QA.

title: AgentEvolver: Towards Efficient Self-Evolving Agent System
problem: Manual task construction, random exploration, and sparse credit assignment make agent reinforcement learning costly.
assumption_broken: Task synthesis, exploration guidance, and step-level learning signals need not be rigid human-engineered inputs.
operational_signature: Explore → synthesize tasks → retrieve guidance → attribute contributions → train
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-questioning, experience-mixed rollouts, and LLM-based action attribution jointly improve task coverage and sample utilization.

improver_modified.how: An evolving experience pool supplies reusable guidance for subsequent exploration and policy learning.

limitations_evident: Validation is limited to AppWorld and BFCL multi-turn tasks.
Several stronger external models perform synthesis and attribution.
Environment profiles and user preferences are manually specified.

title: WebCoach: Self-Evolving Web Agents with Cross-Session Memory Guidance
problem: Web agents repeat navigation errors across sessions because they cannot retain and consult prior experience.
assumption_broken: Improving deployed web agents need not require retraining or altering their internal workflow.
operational_signature: Condense → store episodes → retrieve analogues → selectively advise → accumulate
load_bearing_mechanism: A runtime coach injects concise advice from relevant completed episodes only when intervention appears useful.
limitations_evident: Coaching increases average runtime despite reducing actions.
Performance gains depend on actor model scale.
Live websites introduce changing evaluation conditions.

title: Live-SWE-agent: Can Software Engineering Agents Self-Evolve on the Fly?
problem: Fixed coding-agent toolsets are costly to design and cannot adapt to issue-specific needs at runtime.
assumption_broken: Agent tooling need not be pre-engineered or evolved offline before solving an issue.
operational_signature: Act → inspect feedback → synthesize tool → execute → revise
load_bearing_mechanism: A step-reflection reminder makes custom executable tool creation an ongoing decision interleaved with issue solving.
limitations_evident: Tools are generated per issue rather than shown to accumulate across tasks.
Several comparisons reuse published results with differing backbones.
Implemented evolution focuses on tool scripts rather than changing the core loop.

title: AccelOpt: A Self-Improving LLM Agentic System for AI Accelerator Kernel Optimization
problem: Emerging accelerators lack established kernel optimization expertise and require costly design-space exploration.
assumption_broken: Kernel optimization heuristics need not be supplied by hardware experts before search begins.
operational_signature: Plan → rewrite → profile → retain fast candidates → distill memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Beam search is guided by a bounded memory of distilled slow-fast kernel transformations, including reversed failed optimizations.

improver_modified.how: Optimization memory is curated from measured transformations and changes the planner guidance in later iterations.

limitations_evident: Memory is per kernel; cross-kernel transfer is left to future work.
NKIBench contains only 14 kernels.
Timing excludes compilation and proprietary reasoning-token costs are unavailable.

title: Agent0: Unleashing Self-Evolving Agents from Zero Data via Tool-Integrated Reasoning
problem: Data-free self-evolution stagnates when model-only tasks fail to challenge multi-step tool reasoning.
assumption_broken: A self-generated curriculum need not remain limited to single-turn, tool-free reasoning.
operational_signature: Generate frontier tasks → measure uncertainty → filter → solve with tools → alternate training
load_bearing_mechanism: Tool-use and uncertainty rewards co-evolve curriculum difficulty while ambiguity-aware policy updates reduce noisy majority-label reinforcement.

improver_modified.how: The curriculum agent is reinforcement-trained between executor learning stages.

limitations_evident: Majority-vote pseudo-labels can reinforce shared errors.
Experiments use only two Qwen3 base sizes.
Tool-use rewards are proxies rather than direct guarantees of useful complexity.

title: General Agentic Memory Via Deep Research
problem: Ahead-of-time memory compression loses fine-grained historical details needed by unforeseen requests.
assumption_broken: Memory need not precompute a complete answer-ready representation before the query arrives.
operational_signature: Preserve pages → index highlights → plan search → integrate → reflect
load_bearing_mechanism: A lightweight memorizer preserves full history while a researcher constructs query-specific context through iterative search and reflection.
limitations_evident: Researcher quality degrades with backbones of 7B or smaller.
Additional search and reflection increase test-time computation.
Reinforcement optimization is formulated but not empirically demonstrated in the provided experiments.

title: AutoEnv: Automated Environments for Measuring Cross-Environment Agent Learning
problem: Fixed agent-learning methods lose effectiveness as environment rules become more heterogeneous.
assumption_broken: The learning method itself need not remain fixed across environments.
operational_signature: Generate worlds → collect trajectories → edit components → select candidates → evaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: A component-centric selection, optimization, and evaluation formulation exposes environment-specific learning-method combinations for comparison.
limitations_evident: Only 36 text-focused environments are evaluated.
Environment reliability checks are imperfect.
Per-environment best-method upper bounds are not a deployable general controller.
