assumption_broken: The feedback verifier need not remain fixed while response quality and task demands evolve.
operational_signature: synthesize verifier → score controlled contrasts → diagnose and repair response → admit generalized procedure → evolve verifier at checkpoints
load_bearing_mechanism: Worst-family contrast discrimination selects verifier programs that control both response repair and harness-state admission.

improver_modified.how: Executable verifier criteria and aggregation logic evolve, changing which repairs are accepted.

limitations_evident: Main gains are dominated by current-task repair.
Procedural memory and verifier adapt during evaluation streams.
Constructed contrasts assume a targeted edit changes only its declared property.

title: Coupled Harness--Model Evolution for Scientific Equation Discovery
problem: Missing numerical capabilities and poor tool selection require different interventions.
assumption_broken: Neither a fixed tool library nor a fixed tool-use policy can repair both failure types.
operational_signature: diagnose failed discovery → add tool or revise selection → regression-test library → freeze tools → distill successful trajectories → evaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: Typed failure diagnosis grows executable numerical tools; the student policy explicitly trains to operate that versioned toolkit.
limitations_evident: Development benchmarks contribute to headline evaluation.
External baselines use different models and scoring conventions.
Search cost and run variance are absent in the supplied extract.

title: Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
problem: A successful attempt leaves untested assumptions about a reusable skill’s applicability.
assumption_broken: Expert advice is more useful during learner investigation than as direct expert authoring or post-hoc teaching.
operational_signature: practice anchor → educator challenges assumption → student tests and revises package → resolve learning issue → freeze skill → fresh-session transfer
load_bearing_mechanism: Persistent learning issues condition review timing and preserve evidence of verified or rejected advice.
limitations_evident: Additional model pairs use only a single repeat.
The supplied experimental section is truncated before detailed controls.
Held-out transfer stays within prespecified task families.

title: AReaL-RSI: Adaptive Scaling and Coordination of Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Parallel research wastes resources when early scores dominate guidance or uncertain findings spread without applicability conditions.
assumption_broken: Increasing independent researchers alone does not organize useful progress or preserve reusable research procedures.
operational_signature: select researcher harnesses → investigate persistently → route evidence with conditions → review campaign → revise knowledge and skills → next campaign
load_bearing_mechanism: Source-linked selective sharing and task-oriented researcher harnesses shape ongoing investigations; evidence review publishes later versions.

improver_modified.how: Post-campaign review revises researcher orientations, knowledge, and procedures used in subsequent research.

limitations_evident: Cross-campaign harness evolution gains remain unmeasured.
Reported resources do not establish equal-compute efficiency.
No repeated-run uncertainty is available.

title: Reliable Memory from Unstable Growth: Curating Self-Written Agent Playbooks with Randomized Experiments
problem: Self-written playbooks can become harmful and self-judged helpfulness fails to detect the damage.
assumption_broken: Lesson usefulness must be measured against randomized absence rather than inferred from agent praise or semantic similarity.
operational_signature: grow multiple playbooks → cluster lessons → randomize block inclusion → estimate success effect → budget positive blocks → validate against whole and empty playbooks
load_bearing_mechanism: Factorial randomized inclusion estimates every block’s average marginal effect, followed by an independent practice-stage fallback selection.
limitations_evident: Extra practice episodes are required.
Practice-to-evaluation distribution shifts can preserve harmful playbooks.
Only fixed post-growth playbooks are studied.

title: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
problem: Fixed graph APIs hide relevant evidence even when agents compose their calls in code.
assumption_broken: Graph-access primitives need not be predetermined when the complete graph is exposed as files.
operational_signature: inspect graph files → write traversal code → execute → inspect evidence or errors → revise code → answer → discard programs
load_bearing_mechanism: Multi-turn executable access to complete graph files removes predefined API bottlenecks.
limitations_evident: No tool library is learned across tasks.
Published baselines have different models and budgets.
Main results are single-run point estimates.

title: SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics
problem: Robotic learning curves confound retained experience with retries, privileged simulator information, and stochastic luck.
assumption_broken: Rising task success does not establish persistent or transferable learning.
operational_signature: practice task → freeze policy → sealed test → retain skills and memories → next task → compare restarts and no-library controls
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared benchmark combines frozen-judge views, persistent libraries, equal-time restart controls, and transfer tiers.
limitations_evident: Some AR conditions have only one run.
Agents discovered simulator-state shortcuts despite isolation.
Library contents can preserve harmful beliefs.

title: SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection
problem: Candidate-specific skill rollouts are expensive and plausible guidance can harm a competent policy.
assumption_broken: Skills need neither be injected unconditionally nor survive at deployment to improve exploration.
operational_signature: collect skill-free Scouts → generate skills → compare fixed-trajectory likelihoods → gate positive candidate → execute → jointly update shared weights
load_bearing_mechanism: Outcome-signed likelihood differences replace candidate rollouts for skill selection and Generator reward while environment outcomes train the Executor.

improver_modified.how: The skill Generator is jointly trained with the Executor using policy-relative utility rewards.

limitations_evident: Textual skills and Generator are removed at deployment.
Benchmark split construction is omitted in the supplied extract.
Likelihood utility is a proxy for causal downstream benefit.

title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
problem: Persistent harness edits need an explicit distinction between editable state, proposal mechanisms, and reliable admission.
assumption_broken: Empirical selection of harness revisions alone does not establish generalization or retention.
operational_signature: execute incumbent → diagnose and propose revision → assess under immutable final evaluator → admit or keep incumbent → persist across runs
load_bearing_mechanism: A feedback-continuity taxonomy is paired with conditional stability and concentration arguments for accepting persistent updates.
limitations_evident: The supplied extract ends before the detailed theoretical section.
Empirical cases are attributed to prior work, not a new controlled study.
A cited plugin cost trajectory contains an unresolved discrepancy.

title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: New remote-sensing tasks repeatedly require expert model and training-pipeline engineering.
assumption_broken: People can specify data and verification constraints while an agent designs the complete modeling recipe.
operational_signature: supply harness and verifier → code and train pipeline → score validation → self-train descendants → select submission → hidden final test
load_bearing_mechanism: An isolated verifier exposes end-to-end task metrics while the coding agent controls model architecture, data lineage, and inference code.
limitations_evident: One research trajectory per task-agent condition.
No isolated comparison of a learned improver against a fixed one.
Most deliverables are trained task models rather than persistent agent harnesses.

title: HERO: Harnessing Evidence for Test-time Refinement and Prompt Optimization in Program Generation
problem: Prompt updates fix failures but regress correct cases, while reusable prompts leave instance-specific errors.
assumption_broken: Unverified textual gradients and uniform candidate evaluation are insufficient for reliable prompt changes.
operational_signature: contrast execution histories → propose reusable prompt edits → paired adaptive acceptance → archive and select → freeze prompt → evidence-gated test repair
load_bearing_mechanism: Fix-minus-regression comparisons and uncertainty-directed evaluation protect previous behaviors before prompt replacement.
limitations_evident: Rollout matching excludes differences in reflection, generation, and selection costs.
Some datasets reuse update data for final prompt selection.
Test-time repair correctness partly relies on the same LLM judging its edits.

title: Learning What to Keep: Transfer-Aware Personal Skill Learning from User Feedback
problem: Mixed user feedback combines reusable preferences with request-specific corrections that cause negative transfer if retained indiscriminately.
assumption_broken: Retention need not be decided for a whole feedback message or skill; individual atomic requirements can have separately learned transfer decisions.
operational_signature: Decompose feedback into atomic rules → predict transferability → append reusable rules → generate later responses → jointly train induction and application
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate local credit for rule content and retention decisions trains a skill curator jointly with the skill-conditioned response policy.

improver_modified.how: Reinforcement learning updates the policy that induces and selects reusable personalized rules, jointly with its downstream reader.

limitations_evident: Some user profiles and feedback are synthetic and evaluation is restricted to writing tasks and small models.
Three evaluation seeds are averaged, but uncertainty statistics and training cost are not supplied.
The retained skill is not cleanly removed while keeping the trained reader fixed in the supplied text.

title: EvoWeave: Composing Reusable Agent Experience through Operation Level Graphs
problem: Whole workflows inject irrelevant steps while isolated operations lose the dependencies needed for valid composition.
assumption_broken: Experience need not be retrieved as a whole workflow or as unrelated cards; reusable transitions can preserve explicit contracts and directed dependencies.
operational_signature: Abstract observed operations → index contractual transitions → retrieve and connect fragments → execute with checked bindings → validate memory updates
load_bearing_mechanism: Plan-guided bounded graph search connects reusable operation cards while exposing missing preconditions and inconsistent candidates.
limitations_evident: Memory is built online from the evaluation stream; no independently frozen-memory test is reported.
Episode success is model-judged and token budgets are not equalized.
The supplied extraction truncates efficiency results and omits appendices.

title: STRATA: Self-Maintaining Structured Experience Graphs for Self-Evolving Language Agents
problem: Undifferentiated, ever-growing agent memories retrieve confusable experiences and suffer negative transfer.
assumption_broken: Agent memory can have typed abstraction levels, explicit forgetting, and contrast relations instead of a single monotonically growing similarity pool.
operational_signature: Retrieve typed subgraph → act and observe outcome → write successful procedures or failure warnings → induce abstractions → prune under pressure
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared operation-aware similarity geometry coordinates typed retrieval, abstraction, adaptive write thresholds, garbage collection, and opposition warnings.
limitations_evident: The same sequential benchmark stream supplies memory updates and reported scores.
Opposition warnings use a manually specified lexicon and one model family.
Scaling comparisons confound task count with difficulty; extracted tables lose numeric values.

title: VideoHarness-SRSI: Structured Recursive Self-Improvement for Video Understanding Harness
problem: Repeated noisy validation feedback makes video-harness evolution overfit, dilute search budget, and prematurely abandon useful mechanisms.
assumption_broken: Giving a harness proposer rich instance-level feedback and jointly evolving all mechanisms is not necessarily the best search organization.
operational_signature: Isolate content-free feedback → instrument warm-up contrasts → evolve isolated mechanism branches → compose and refine → select by validation → certify held-out
load_bearing_mechanism: Content-free feedback and staged controlled mechanism search make validation evidence more transferable and informative before selection commits.
limitations_evident: Held-out gains are within each benchmark, not transfer of one evolved design across benchmarks.
Most explicit cost matching concerns deployment frames; complete search cost is absent from supplied sections.
The extraction truncates diagnostics and ablations and omits the main structured-method section.

title: EvoProbe: Evaluation-Driven Benchmark Evolution for LLM Agents
problem: Static agent benchmarks saturate and aggregate outcomes do not explain which capabilities newly generated tasks should probe.
assumption_broken: Benchmark regeneration can be conditioned on verified phase bottlenecks and trajectory patterns rather than aggregate difficulty alone.
operational_signature: Generate executable tasks → validate scoring and solvability → collect multi-run outcomes and trajectory diagnoses → extract bottlenecks → regenerate and review tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Phase-level executable outcomes and evidence-grounded multi-judge diagnoses become retained feedback for generating the next benchmark round.
limitations_evident: Only two rounds in cybersecurity are evaluated and human reviewers decide task retention.
Task selection and diagnostic generation use the same evaluated model pool; there is no independent frozen-artifact transfer test.
Three runs are aggregated without reported variance in the supplied text; trajectory diagnostics select the best run.

title: XferAgent: Cross-Agent Experience Transfer for Self-Improving LLM Agents
problem: Experience shared by heterogeneous agents is difficult to reconcile and may be irrelevant or incompatible with the receiving agent’s local history.
assumption_broken: Cross-agent sharing need not be one flat shared pool; provenance-preserving graph reconciliation and local/shared routing can select complementary experience.
operational_signature: Abstract completed executions → reconcile shared contributions → route a connected task subgraph → fuse local experience → use outcome statistics to rank → update after execution
load_bearing_mechanism: Connected shared-graph routing combines semantic relevance, leave-one-agent-out outcome evidence, and contributor support before integration with local memory.
limitations_evident: Repeated-task recovery is cumulative success and its no-memory baseline does not control repeated attempts.
Cross-framework gains confound agent count with total learning exposure.
Raw-task removal gives no formal privacy guarantee or pretraining-contamination assurance.

title: L3M: A Verifiable Harness and Runtime for Self-Extending and Self-Improving Agents
problem: Long-running agents cannot safely turn repeated model-mediated procedures into reusable machinery if authority and recovery require human attention at every step.
assumption_broken: Coordination, waiting, recovery, and recurring procedures need not remain repeated model reasoning; a typed runtime can make them durable executable primitives.
operational_signature: Recognize a recurring procedure → write a sealed program → type-check its requested capabilities → expose it as a tool → preserve state and authority in a reversible runtime
load_bearing_mechanism: Sealed Lean extension programs use their types as capability requests, allowing persistent tool growth while kernel-checked invariants prevent authority expansion.
limitations_evident: This is primarily an enabling runtime, with no measured autonomous multi-generation improvement or held-out reuse of learned programs.
Type-checked authority guarantees do not establish a new tool’s functional correctness.
The supplied extraction omits the extension-method sections, and the evaluation has only 37 selected tasks.

title: TimeRSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models
problem: Frozen time-series models leave task-specific input design and recurring forecast corrections to expensive human pipeline engineering.
assumption_broken: Deployment transformations around a frozen forecaster can be revised from historical errors rather than remaining fixed human choices.
operational_signature: Generate pipeline revisions → execute on earlier historical windows → inspect errors and logs → retain candidates selected on later windows → select causally for each forecast
load_bearing_mechanism: Feedback-guided code revision builds a deployment portfolio, while similarity-weighted completed-window errors decide which retained pipeline to use next.
limitations_evident: The supplied main text names adaptation and selection windows but leaves exact benchmark test separation to omitted appendices.
Candidate counts are matched, but search calls, tokens, and runtime are not reported.
Task-specific pipelines rely on clear semantic descriptions and can fail under distribution shift.

title: Evolve Together, Fall into Place: How Social Scaffolding Shapes Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Self-evolving teams conflate their update mechanism with the social conditions that determine who learns, shares, and controls team changes.
assumption_broken: Team composition and interdependence need not be fixed implementation details or uncontrolled products of evolution; they can be independent experimental variables.
operational_signature: Fix evolution mechanism → vary composition and interdependence → evolve individual and team state → gate harmful revisions → compare frozen evolved and unevolved teams
load_bearing_mechanism: Factorial interventions on social scaffolding across three update mechanisms reveal conditional gains and redistribution of authority toward the strongest member.

improver_modified.how: The existing L1 update mechanisms are fixed across scaffolding conditions; evolved roles, memos, and team configurations are the task system.

limitations_evident: Each condition has one evolution run; standard deviations reflect three reevaluations of the same evolved team.
Benchmark/model ability and shared-GPU serving effects remain confounded.
Crashed sessions are excluded and the supplied extraction omits detailed results sections.

title: LAGO: Language Agents with Reusable Growing Options
problem: Monolithic tool loops and static teams repeatedly solve specialized subproblems without accumulating reusable verified agent capabilities.
assumption_broken: Specialized sub-agents can become reusable temporally extended options in a growing action space rather than fixed roles or disposable workers.
operational_signature: Decompose task → retrieve or spawn a specialist → verify result → admit novel option → reuse and govern the growing library
load_bearing_mechanism: A meta-agent grows a verified library of reusable agent-options and falls back to primitive tool use when none fits.

improver_modified.how: The main meta-agent remains frozen; supplementary SFT changes task decomposition rather than demonstrating an evolved admission or improvement procedure.

limitations_evident: The seed-library contamination discussion is truncated before identifying its source-task separation.
Main scaffolds share policy and attempts but not context or inference budgets; component ablations use only 50 tasks.
Cross-domain reruns do not establish transfer of the same retained library, and single-attempt intervals are not multi-run variance.

title: When Non-Adversarial Noise Hurts Learning: Benchmarking Skill Self-Evolution in Agents
problem: Ordinary noise can corrupt learned skills even when later execution is clean.
assumption_broken: A robust frozen skill store does not imply that the process learning that store tolerates noise.
operational_signature: Perturb one learning input → evolve skills → select and freeze the store → evaluate matched clean and noisy held-out tasks.
load_bearing_mechanism: Separating perturbation entry points and learning/evaluation phases isolates persistent learning damage from execution sensitivity.

improver_modified.how: Existing methods run through a fixed interface without condition-specific modifications.

limitations_evident: Detailed method, experiments, and diagnostics are capped in the supplied text.
Some analyses cover only ACE on SpreadsheetBench.
No optimizer cost or code URL is visible in the supplied extract.

title: AtomSearch: Evidence-Grounded Tree Search for Agent Skill Optimization
problem: Immediate-score selection can discard locally weak skill edits that enable later gains.
assumption_broken: The granularity of an edit need not determine the horizon used to judge its value.
operational_signature: Contrast successes and failures → propose atomic rule edits → execute short compositions → retain tree states → reuse outcome records.
load_bearing_mechanism: Tree search preserves evaluated edit compositions so descendants can justify revisiting a locally weak revision path.

improver_modified.how: Outcome memory informs proposals, but the UCT, widening, reward, and proposal procedure are fixed.

limitations_evident: Point estimates rather than significance claims.
Component ablation covers one task and target model.
Additional offline evaluations are not a matched-budget comparison.

title: MMLA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through RTT and RTMA
problem: A useful state update does not establish that the mechanism producing updates recursively improves.
assumption_broken: The adaptation rule itself can be a bounded editable object, distinct from the state it updates.
operational_signature: Run current adaptation rule → propose a successor rule → independently admit it → replace the rule → generate another successor.
load_bearing_mechanism: An admitted updater or memory manager becomes the same functional rule that produces the next generation.

improver_modified.how: The proposed construction replaces numerical updater and memory-manager rules that participate in subsequent rule discovery; beneficial chains are not demonstrated.

limitations_evident: Beneficial recursive chains and discovery efficiency remain unevaluated.
Reported component gains do not validate the proposed full recursive mechanism.
Supplied extract omits later method and component-study sections.

title: Reflect After Failure: Brain-Inspired Self-Evolving Agents for Embodied Spatial Intelligence
problem: Embodied failures conflate perception, exploration, and planning, causing unreliable experience consolidation.
assumption_broken: Execution failure alone is insufficient to decide which reusable spatial strategy should be retained.
operational_signature: Execute with frozen memory → diagnose perception/exploration/planning → contrast attempts → consolidate strategies and validate skills → freeze next-round memory.
load_bearing_mechanism: Structured failure attribution grounds contrastive reflection and execution-gated memory consolidation.

improver_modified.how: The PEP diagnostic and reflection procedure remain fixed while strategies and executable skills change.

limitations_evident: Headline gains reuse 208 fixed episodes during adaptation.
Held-out transfer consists of qualitative source-target cases within the same subtask.
Reported runtime excludes reflection and memory-update costs.

title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
problem: Whole-program scores obscure whether a hypothesis failed or its implementation was inadequate, and hide reusable partial results.
assumption_broken: A program without an overall gain can still contain useful components or an unrealized hypothesis for later research.
operational_signature: Execute scientific candidates → record hypotheses, implementations, and failures → adaptively select revision mode → mutate or recombine → retain shared research states.
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared graph separates hypotheses from implementations and carries unresolved needs into adaptive mutation and complementary recombination.

improver_modified.how: Research states change the inputs to a fixed mutation, recombination, and discounted-UCB selection procedure.

limitations_evident: Some published baselines retain their original unmatched settings.
One-seed trajectory analyses are descriptive.
Main NatureBench search gains and separate held-out transfer have different evidential roles.

title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
problem: Training an executor for failures caused by its calling harness wastes compute and can degrade existing skills.
assumption_broken: A persistent failure need not require a weight update; it may require a better instruction, pose, or procedure.
operational_signature: Refine harness → replay failing substeps from saved states → collect demonstrations for executor-limited gaps → train and validate policies → deploy retained harness and policies.
load_bearing_mechanism: Retrying the same failing substep under alternative calls distinguishes harness defects from missing executor motions.

improver_modified.how: Pilot experience informs a fixed harness-first, attribution-then-training procedure; the procedure itself is not rewritten.

limitations_evident: All experiments are simulated.
Development improvements can reverse on test scenes.
No repeated-seed uncertainty or matched total optimization budget is visible.

title: EvolvingBrain: An Adaptive Skill System for Multi-modal Agents Self-Evolution in Open Worlds
problem: Successful-trajectory skill induction misses failures and provides knowledge at inappropriate granularities.
assumption_broken: Task success does not imply every trajectory segment is useful, and failure does not imply every segment is useless.
operational_signature: Collect own trajectories → identify procedural and problematic patterns → retry and refine skills → organize hierarchy → freeze and retrieve by current state.
load_bearing_mechanism: Procedural and failure-specific skills are jointly evolved at multiple granularities, then retrieved adaptively from execution state.

improver_modified.how: Skill content evolves under a fixed pattern extraction and retry/refinement procedure.

limitations_evident: No seed variance is visible in the supplied extract.
Equal execution budget does not equalize skill-construction compute.
Real-world evaluation and online skill-evolution efficiency remain future work.

title: A Self-Improving Agent that Grows its Own DSL: Oracle-Free Operator Induction for Exact Question Answering
problem: A self-extended operator library can grow in coverage while silently accepting semantically wrong operators.
assumption_broken: Reward, model judgment, or compression is not required to admit new executable capabilities, nor sufficient for exactness.
operational_signature: Generate new questions → discover operator gap → write two implementations → test agreement and conservation → register operator → expand questions again.
load_bearing_mechanism: Independent differential checks plus conservation laws over trusted primitives gate operator admission without an answer key.

improver_modified.how: Operators expand the answer space; the induction and admission mechanism remains fixed.

limitations_evident: Main coverage trajectory repeatedly uses fixed admission-validation records.
Independent held-out gold checks do not clearly isolate transfer of induced operators.
Finite empirical tests and shared implementation bugs do not provide universal correctness.

title: Evolving Together, Failing Apart: The Skill-Policy Co-evolution Trap in Self-Improving Agents
problem: Delivered policy-bank success hides brittleness when skill content drifts after deployment.
assumption_broken: Performance on the co-evolved final bank is not sufficient evidence of robust skill use.
operational_signature: Freeze delivered bank and variants → perturb content with retrieval fixed → replay policy checkpoints → compare peak and drifted success.
load_bearing_mechanism: Content-only perturbations and fixed-bank longitudinal probes separate skill drift from retrieval changes and policy competence.

improver_modified.how: The contribution audits fixed co-evolution methods rather than evolving an improvement mechanism.

limitations_evident: Theory depends on idealized cooperative acceptance and candidate coverage.
Finite perturbations only lower-bound worst-case fragility.
Supplied file truncates experimental setup before full result and protocol details.

title: SkillNEO: Non-Elitist Evolutionary Optimization of Agent Skills
problem: Elitist selection discards partially repaired skill bundles before dependent fixes can pay off.
assumption_broken: A bundle unsuitable for current deployment can still be a valuable parent or procedure donor.
operational_signature: Compare related execution histories → diagnose skill defects → edit bundles → retain offspring for development → independently promote deployment incumbents.
load_bearing_mechanism: Offspring-only parent selection preserves lower-scoring partial repairs while conservative deployment retains the best measured bundle.

improver_modified.how: The fixed proposer, editor, and non-elitist selection rules operate on evolving task-specific skill bundles.

limitations_evident: Development and final evaluation reuse the same task instances.
No new-instance skill generalization is established.
Selected development histories and cross-model reuse do not isolate a matched-budget optimizer advantage.

title: CausalEvo: Causal Skill Self-Evolution for Health LLM Agents
problem: Skill retention can propagate faulty rules when content utility is confounded by changed capacity or uncontrolled feedback.
assumption_broken: Generating a replacement is not evidence that it should displace an incumbent rule.
operational_signature: Pool incumbent and proposed rules → run paired fixed-capacity exchanges → estimate rule credits → retain top rules with incumbent tie-breaking.
load_bearing_mechanism: Shared-background paired rule exchanges and least-squares credit isolate relative rule value at fixed capacity.

improver_modified.how: The exchange estimator and retention controller remain fixed while rule content changes.

limitations_evident: One training trajectory and unequal optimization budgets.
Aggregate improvement is not significant and includes task regressions.
Credit ablation reuses development data and patient-level independence remains unverified.

title: Recursive Reward Improvement via Adversarial Meta-Prompt Evolution
problem: Self-generated open-ended rubrics reward superficial or incorrect answers and corrupt solver training.
assumption_broken: A generated reward can be actively attacked and revised before it supervises learning.
operational_signature: Generate grounded tasks and rubrics → contrast exploit and honest responses → repair reward criteria → train solver → rewrite future generation guidance.
load_bearing_mechanism: An exploit-versus-honest contrast selects reward repairs and propagates failures into persistent proposer guidance.

improver_modified.how: The meta-optimizer rewrites guidance governing future task and rubric generation, using confirmed exploits and training feedback.

limitations_evident: No matched total improvement budget or repeated-training uncertainty is visible.
All tasks enter training after two repair rounds even if still exploitable.
Same-model honest answers and judges may share blind spots despite retrieval grounding.

title: MemScope: Evolving Agent Memory Architectures through Localized Code Repair
problem: Score-only architecture evolution cannot localize memory failures and causes unnecessarily broad rewrites.
assumption_broken: Memory storage and retrieval code can be repaired locally from raw runtime evidence while retaining existing records.
operational_signature: Execute task stream → inspect traces, memory, and provider code → localize failure → validate bounded patch → retain provider and continue learning.
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint inspection of traces, runtime memory, and source identifies bounded repair regions rather than regenerating whole architectures.

improver_modified.how: Executable memory_storage and memory_retrieval mechanisms are patched, changing how later task experience is distilled, stored, and reused.

limitations_evident: Some headline evaluations include online memory updates and reused development tasks.
No repeated-seed uncertainty is visible.
Optimization-cost discussion is referenced in an appendix absent from the supplied extract.

title: AutoOnboarder: Autonomously Onboarding LLM Agents
problem: Browser-agent harness overhead can prevent capable models from detecting consequential task errors.
assumption_broken: Adapting an agent can jointly alter its prompt, model choice, and harness rather than optimize a fixed wrapper.
operational_signature: Edit one lever → run onboarding cases → inspect logs and feedback → keep or revert → nominate one cost-feasible candidate for isolated evaluation.
load_bearing_mechanism: An autonomous coding supervisor can alter all executor-visible components while final evaluation data resides on a separate machine.

improver_modified.how: The supervisor and its contract are fixed; only the executor model identifier, prompt, and harness are edited.

limitations_evident: One cost-infeasible onboarding run is excluded from validation.
High run-to-run onboarding variance and tiny lever-comparison samples.
One synthetic clinical paperwork domain; no candidate is dependable for clinical use.

title: FedSkillGit: Federated Skill Evolution via Version Control
problem: Federated whole-document skill updates leak client detail, waste communication, and obscure individual contributions.
assumption_broken: The unit of federated skill collaboration can be a bounded semantic commit rather than a whole document.
operational_signature: Execute locally → generate rule patch and experience → sanitize and audit → merge commits → validate across clients → publish improved document.
load_bearing_mechanism: Privacy-filtered rule-level commits with shared optimizer experience make client contributions identifiable and reusable across rounds.

improver_modified.how: The commit, filtering, merging, and publication procedure is fixed; its skill document and optimizer experience content evolve.

limitations_evident: One shared document cannot personalize per client.
Privacy auditing is limited to a fixed private-value set.
Per-round matching does not establish equal total optimization tokens or evaluations.

title: Identifying Effective Strategies in Prompt Evolution for Stress and Emotion Prediction
problem: Prompt-evolution gains vary by task and model, with unclear links between individual strategies and reported performance.
assumption_broken: A useful-looking instruction edit or local comparison gain need not improve full-development or final-test performance.
operational_signature: Run prompt optimizers → retain selected instruction pairs → trace revisions and strategy combinations → compare development and exploratory test behavior.
load_bearing_mechanism: Linked prompt ancestry and evaluation records expose instruction errors and discrepancies between local, development, and reported test rankings.

improver_modified.how: The study compares fixed prompt optimizers and an optional merge operation; their mechanisms do not self-modify.

limitations_evident: Test panel mixes historically exposed and separately sampled items, not globally untouched data.
Different optimizer budget units do not equalize total model calls or tokens.
Incomplete scores remain missing and individual strategy effects are not isolated.

title: MetaExp: Learning to Self-Improve through Experience via Verifiable Cross-Task Environment Scaling
problem: Task-specific experience training may not transfer to new distributions.
assumption_broken: Experience acquisition itself can be a trained transferable capability.
operational_signature: construct reusable task families → verify → collect sequential traces → train writer and reader → freeze weights → evolve skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled shared factors across task families supervise transferable experience learning.

improver_modified.how: Supervised training changes the model that writes and consumes experience, while deployment weights remain frozen.

limitations_evident: Writer and reader weights change together, limiting isolated improver attribution.
Three randomized orders are reported, but uncertainty statistics are not visible in the supplied extraction.
Published system baselines use their original evolution protocols.

title: The Self-Improvement Problem
problem: Terminating gates cannot universally certify unbounded semantic improvements.
assumption_broken: Computable acceptance cannot simultaneously guarantee soundness and completeness for arbitrary self-referential agents.
operational_signature: formalize semantic improvement → construct counterexample → bound evaluation and proposals → establish proxy guarantees → expose drift
load_bearing_mechanism: Diagonal constructions distinguish universal semantic certification from bounded-proxy decidability.
limitations_evident: Theoretical worst-case result, not empirical evidence of an improved retained artifact.
Extracted mathematical notation is removed, limiting verification of formal details.
Bounded-score guarantees do not control the true unbounded objective.

title: RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent
problem: A fixed improvement workflow cannot adapt to shifting agent bottlenecks.
assumption_broken: Workflow orchestration is itself an editable capability.
operational_signature: diagnose bottleneck → choose component update → validate candidate → contrast outcomes → revise meta-skills and harness
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-update outcomes modify the meta-agent interfaces and reusable orchestration knowledge.

improver_modified.how: The meta-agent changes its own action interfaces, retrieval calls, instructions, and meta-skills from task-update outcomes.

limitations_evident: Same-initial-agent meta comparisons are present, but matched total meta-optimization cost is not established.
Extraction omits detailed split and variance protocols.
Task agents are small backbones; meta-harness stability remains untested at scale.

title: MetaShare: Failure-Aware Collective Self-Improvement for Open-Ended Agents
problem: Raw archives hide which mechanisms caused regressions and encourage redundant search.
assumption_broken: Failed modifications should persist as reusable signed cross-lineage knowledge.
operational_signature: evaluate patch → summarize signed mechanism → retrieve diverse successes and failures → audit coverage → propose → structurally gate
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate success and avoid channels carry compact evaluated mechanism records across branches.
limitations_evident: Polyglot reuses evaluation tasks; other domains have held-out splits.
Only two domains rerun baseline behind the same gate; others use published baseline results.
Fixed retrieval and auditing machinery is not itself evolved; cross-domain experiments do not establish artifact transfer.

title: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
problem: Aggregate evolution gains conflate reusable improvements, shortcuts, and extra inference compute.
assumption_broken: A higher search score need not imply a better transferable harness.
operational_signature: evolve → test gain significance → match inference compute → neutralize shortcuts → estimate residual → evaluate held-out
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled compute scaling and minimal shortcut removal bound explanations of harness gains.
limitations_evident: Neutralization covers only detected separable shortcuts; residual is an upper bound, not verified generalization.
Inference compute matching does not match the evolution search cost.
Paired bootstrap over task scores does not establish independent evolution-run variance.

title: R$^2$Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
problem: Curriculum shifts confound skill utility and can collapse training advantages.
assumption_broken: Skill withdrawal should depend on causal contribution rather than overall success rate.
operational_signature: self-play → random skill withholding → estimate benefit → update curriculum and policy → revise or retire skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Shared randomized rollout groups estimate skill effects while training the policy to operate without them.
limitations_evident: Final zero-skill gains are retained in trained weights, not evidence of a retained non-weight artifact.
Initial skills are manually customized per dataset.
Full optimizer cost matching and run variance are not visible in the supplied extraction.

title: When Can You Trust an Agent's Own Verifier? Stress-Testing Counterfactual Rationale Verification Under Search Pressure and Oracle Access
problem: A verifier can appear robust because optimization barely uses it.
assumption_broken: Absence of discovered exploitation is not evidence of resistance under effective pressure.
operational_signature: measure pressure → vary incentive → control capability → vary oracle access → compare held-out fidelity
load_bearing_mechanism: Four falsifiable interventions separate absent signals, weak pressure, claim selection, and pre-commit access.
limitations_evident: One verifier and generator; six narrow pipeline tasks and short horizons.
Search omits claim counts, limiting the interpretation of absent claim minimization.
Small-pipeline estimator behavior partly confounds observed fidelity declines.

title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
problem: A harness optimized for an earlier policy may miss current failures.
assumption_broken: Policy and harness should adapt through a shared failure-driven interface.
operational_signature: inspect failures → propose harness edits → select → train policy → identify hard tasks → retarget harness search
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy-training failures define the next harness search set and the policy becomes its own proposer.

improver_modified.how: Policy training changes the model used as the next harness proposer, although the search algorithm remains fixed.

limitations_evident: Only two alternating rounds and one base policy are tested.
Evaluation-run variance is reported, not independent evolution-run variance.
An isolated matched-budget old-versus-updated proposer comparison is not established.

title: Evo-B&B: Behavior-Aware LLM-Guided Joint Evolution of Branching and Node Selection Policies for MILP
problem: Joint policy search wastes solver evaluations on behaviorally redundant candidates.
assumption_broken: Code diversity need not imply decision diversity.
operational_signature: generate joint policy → execute solver → compare behavioral signatures → retain Pareto-diverse policies
load_bearing_mechanism: Fixed decision probes measure behavioral redundancy for population admission and parent selection.
limitations_evident: Supplied extraction truncates sections and omits tables or appendices.
Independent whole-search variance and matched optimization cost are not established in the supplied text.

title: When to Forget: Risk-Controlled Context Adaptation for Long-Horizon Agents
problem: Failure histories can become harmful or redundant as execution progresses.
assumption_broken: The same failure block should not always be retained.
operational_signature: compare context interventions → predict useful edits → certify risk constraints → select policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Matched execution comparisons and independent certification constrain context-removal risk.
limitations_evident: Full text unavailable: abstract-only extraction; experimental evidence remains unclear.

title: Reward Engine: Reward-Centric Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Tool Agents
problem: Open-ended tool outputs lack reliable executable rewards.
assumption_broken: Reward construction must be tested and stationary rather than an unchecked moving judge.
operational_signature: draft obligations → bind evidence checks → test counterexamples → preserve prior agreements → freeze and select outputs
load_bearing_mechanism: Regression-gated reward repair preserves accumulated reference judgments while the round uses a frozen pack.
limitations_evident: Reward ordering evaluation may reuse candidates the packs have seen.
Total optimizer cost and equal-budget comparison are not reported.
Reference labels are fallible model judgments; their accuracy is not measured.

title: Self-Evolving Agents Can Repair Failures but Struggle to Generalize from Them
problem: Local recovery can be mistaken for transferable self-improvement.
assumption_broken: Correctly diagnosed failures need not yield reusable capabilities.
operational_signature: isolate failed trajectories → evolve external artifacts → freeze held-out evaluation → intervene on learning signals
load_bearing_mechanism: Failure-only, feedback-blind streams separate task repair from generalization.
limitations_evident: Only finite evolution horizons, up to 800 ALFWorld tasks, are tested.
Failure-dense selected streams restrict deployment generalization.
Supplied extraction truncates causal analyses and does not establish search-seed variance.

title: Darwin-Claw: Environment-Adaptive Experience Consolidation for Recursively Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Uncontrolled trace accumulation obscures useful situational experience.
assumption_broken: All extracted experience need not deserve permanent skill context.
operational_signature: parse new traces → triage experience → assess attributed utility → probation → promote or evict
load_bearing_mechanism: Bounded skill slots and TTL probation govern retention of experience units.
limitations_evident: LLM-based reliance attribution is not a randomized paired-rollout causal estimate.
Disjoint evolution and evaluation tasks are not specified in the supplied text.
Matched computational budget is claimed without separated optimizer-cost accounting.

title: From Trajectories to Differentiated Skills: Cognitive Differentiation for Self-Improving Agents
problem: Monolithic skill artifacts mix behavioral functions with different maintenance needs.
assumption_broken: Artifact boundaries need not define knowledge maintenance and use.
operational_signature: contrast outcomes → ground lessons in traces → assign functional roles → specialized update → coordinate and validate → selective loading
load_bearing_mechanism: Meta, Experience, Tool and Script receive distinct update and validation operators.
limitations_evident: Multi-round experiments reuse a fixed corpus, not a changing environment.
Reported cost focuses on input tokens; end-to-end optimizer budget matching is not established.
Repeated-search seeds and variance are not established by the extraction.

title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
problem: Monolithic rewriting loses field boundaries and reusable knowledge.
assumption_broken: One unrestricted instruction need not hold all reusable editing strategies.
operational_signature: deploy field-scoped behaviors → observe ranking deltas → propose edits → deduplicate → commit and deactivate → freeze for evaluation
load_bearing_mechanism: Structured field scope and moderated delta operations preserve reusable behavior knowledge.
limitations_evident: Episode reward credits every co-applied behavior, without isolating its causal contribution.
Modified behaviors inherit old counts and cannot be reverted automatically.
Editor and training ranker share GPT-5.4; cross-ranker results are cut off in the extraction.

title: RedDarwin: Evolving Jailbreak Skills against Frontier LLMs
problem: Prompt search leaves attack algorithms fixed.
assumption_broken: The procedure generating test inputs can itself be revised and recombined.
operational_signature: select procedures → revise or compose → execute → compare development fitness → retain → freeze and transfer
load_bearing_mechanism: A common executable skill interface makes algorithmic control flow an evolutionary target.
limitations_evident: Matched target-query budgets do not establish matched full evolutionary optimizer cost.
Search-seed variance is not established in the supplied text.
One unseen target shares a model family with a development target.

title: DrugHarness: An Evolvable Agent Harness for Computational Drug Discovery
problem: Scientific experience can yield poorly scoped or unverified action guidance.
assumption_broken: Recommendations need observable conditions and reviewed evidence rather than generic reuse.
operational_signature: compare experience → induce conditional hypothesis → construct skill → independent source and execution review → admit → revise from feedback
load_bearing_mechanism: Independent review gates condition-scoped skills using scientific sources and targeted trials.
limitations_evident: Evolution gains are retrospective on skill-development tasks, with historical no-skill controls.
Prospective wet-lab validation does not isolate an evolved-skill benefit.
Matched cost comparisons and unseen-task evolution evaluation remain future work.
